title: Marian gets the Embers job while he is ill
summary: He gets the flu and has Marian audition at the Embers, launching her own trio.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: very bad. So I called up the guy at the Embers. I can't think of his name now, right now and told him you know, audition Marian, she's ready, with the trio, she'll do great.

And so she got the job, at the Embers. And she was there, as a matter of fact I think it was Coleman Hawkins, they had a quartet. And Marian was part of the trio of Coleman Hawkins. And she started going and she's had her trio ever since. But we really.......
Well that's how it happened then, ahah?

I got sick with the flu. I was very ill. I was very ill. Bad flu, I mean I was sort of going out of my mind like. I went into a, I don't know, ah, hallucinations and everything, just from being sick. Strept throat I had and everything.
But Marian, but then she went into the Hickory House and stayed there for a couple, two or three years off and on. But she's quite compatible in any idiom of jazz or music.
